description: This file defines a controller class for managing 'Information' items in the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for listing, viewing, editing, and creating information entries, handling form submissions, and generating views with data like breadcrumbs, store options, and SEO URLs.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Controller class for managing information entries within the catalog section of the OpenCart admin panel. It handles listing, editing, and form processing for information items.
